events.title: Peace Memorial Park & A-Bomb Dome
events.description: Sobering UNESCO site with museum, cenotaph and the preserved Genbaku Dome, commemorating 6 Aug 1945.

events.title: Hiroshima Castle (Rijō)
events.description: Reconstructed keep and local history museum set amid a wide moat and leafy grounds.

events.title: Itsukushima Shrine (Miyajima)
events.description: Iconic ‘floating’ torii and shrine buildings over the tide on Itsukushima Island (Hatsukaichi).
